en.content:
In which of the following reactions H2O2 acts as a reducing agent?
1. H2O2 + 2H+ + 2e- 2H2O
2. H2O2 - 2e- O2 + 2H+
3. H2O2 + 2e- 2OH-
4. H2O2 + 2OH- - 2e- O2 + 2H2O
en.explanation: The reducing agent loses electron during redox reaction i.e. oxidises itself.
